title: Point to another route
summary: Fiber: Point to another route. Inspect the first 302 response.
introduction: Redirect sends a location and status. A browser following GET /start reaches /hello.
learningObjectives: Point to another route with Fiber

blocks.text: Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Point to another route
blocks.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/start", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.Redirect("/hello", 302) })
app.Get("/hello", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.SendString("Welcome") })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

blocks.text: Redirect writes a 302 response with /hello as its location.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A redirect requires another client request.
